purpose: Blind adjudication packet for the 20 reserve samples drawn to replace final-independent-set samples excluded under the frozen adjudication rubric (non-null ambiguity_flag). No system output of any kind is present.
note: No COMQUTOR Alpha prediction, mapper score, plausible_alphas, system confidence, Provider result, or any Candidate 1/2/3 result is present anywhere in this document. Fields mirror the final adjudication packet's own schema exactly.

taxonomy_reference.core_thesis: Falling rates lower discount rates and support long-duration growth assets.
Improving liquidity supports risk appetite and equity inflows.
AI training and adoption increase demand for accelerators and AI-related equities.
Enterprise AI applications and AI agents increase inference compute demand.
AI buildout drives datacenter, power, cooling, networking, and server demand.
A chip-cycle upturn improves inventory, pricing, capex, and semiconductor demand.
Strong demand raises revenue guidance, EPS revisions, and repricing potential.
Rich valuation and high multiples create downside risk despite strong fundamentals.
Widening credit spreads and economic slowdown pressure earnings and risk appetite.
Investor attention and crowded narratives drive reflexive flows and momentum.

label_field_instructions.expected_label: One canonical alpha_id from taxonomy_reference above, or the string 'NONE'. Leave null until adjudicated.
label_field_instructions.ambiguity_flag: null, or one of: BOTH_REASONABLE_AMBIGUOUS | INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT | NOT_A_SUBSTANTIVE_CLAIM | DUPLICATE_OR_NEAR_DUPLICATE
label_field_instructions.adjudication_reason: Short free-text justification, required even for NONE. Leave null until adjudicated.
